name: eveoy
description: Your Eveoy expert in any AI — learn how it works, get a price, and order real in-store visits.
long_description: The Eveoy MCP. Real customers · in real stores · from any AI. You don't pay for tokens, you don't pay for clicks, you don't pay for hope. You pay $24.99 per real customer who walked into your store, spent 10 minutes, and brought back the photos to prove it. $999 entry pilot for 40+ customers. 100% refunded for no-shows.
